title: Spartacus No Training

nodes.speaker: Spartacus Doom
nodes.text: YOUR DOOM. YOU ARE LOOKING AT IT.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: YOUR DOOM. YOU ARE LOOKING AT IT.

nodes.speaker: Spartacus Doom
nodes.text: Not really. I fought OBLITERATA FOUR. It was a draw.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Not really. I fought OBLITERATA FOUR. It was a draw.

nodes.speaker: Spartacus Doom
nodes.text: And I really hope you trip over your FLAVR unit and break your face.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And I really hope you trip over your FLAVR unit and break your face.

nodes.speaker: Spartacus Doom
nodes.text: Yeah. This time to the death.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah. This time to the death.
Don't pretend you care, human.

nodes.speaker: Spartacus Doom
nodes.text: I don’t know. I’m tired, right down to my spikes. Maybe too tired to keep fighting.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don’t know. I’m tired, right down to my spikes. Maybe too tired to keep fighting.

nodes.speaker: Spartacus Doom
nodes.text: I’ve spent my whole life doing what other people want. "Shatter this, Spartacus, pulverize that, Mr. Doom." But you don’t seem to give a shit about anything. It’s kinda refreshing.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I’ve spent my whole life doing what other people want. "Shatter this, Spartacus, pulverize that, Mr. Doom." But you don’t seem to give a shit about anything. It’s kinda refreshing.
Maybe I will.
WHAT DID YOU SAY?
Yeah? Like what?

nodes.speaker: Spartacus Doom
nodes.text: Could've guessed you'd be looking out for number one. Now if you’ll excuse me, I’ve got one of those "final days on this earth" bucket lists to get through.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Could've guessed you'd be looking out for number one. Now if you’ll excuse me, I’ve got one of those "final days on this earth" bucket lists to get through.

nodes.speaker: Spartacus Doom
nodes.text: Spoken like a true Corpster. Now if you’ll excuse me, I’ve got one of those "final days on this earth" bucket lists to get through.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Spoken like a true Corpster. Now if you’ll excuse me, I’ve got one of those "final days on this earth" bucket lists to get through.

nodes.speaker: Spartacus Doom
nodes.text: You have friends? Guess it takes all sorts. Now if you’ll excuse me, I’ve got one of those "final days on this earth" bucket lists to get through.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You have friends? Guess it takes all sorts. Now if you’ll excuse me, I’ve got one of those "final days on this earth" bucket lists to get through.
Are you OK?
I’m really not interested.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So does that mean you have to fight again?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So does that mean you have to fight again?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So does that mean you have to fight again?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So does that mean you have to fight again?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Cool.
That's terrible.
But you’ll win, right?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why are you telling me this?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why are you telling me this?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Why are you telling me this?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Why are you telling me this?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yeah, you look it. A bust-up HumourBot would have more of a chance than you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah, you look it. A bust-up HumourBot would have more of a chance than you.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Yeah, you look it. A bust-up HumourBot would have more of a chance than you.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Yeah, you look it. A bust-up HumourBot would have more of a chance than you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You should try it sometime.
Good luck.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I’d say good luck but to be honest I think my FLAVR unit could beat you in the ring right now.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I’d say good luck but to be honest I think my FLAVR unit could beat you in the ring right now.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I’d say good luck but to be honest I think my FLAVR unit could beat you in the ring right now.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I’d say good luck but to be honest I think my FLAVR unit could beat you in the ring right now.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You heard me. You don’t like it, go prove me wrong.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You heard me. You don’t like it, go prove me wrong.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You heard me. You don’t like it, go prove me wrong.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You heard me. You don’t like it, go prove me wrong.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Hey, I give a shit about things.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hey, I give a shit about things.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Hey, I give a shit about things.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Hey, I give a shit about things.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: My business.
My friends.
My life.
